verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a zero retention policy covering inputs, outputs, and user data, backed by SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification, and offers dedicated private-endpoint instances for data isolation. This is a fixed vendor-side policy, not a user-facing control: there is no evidence of configurable retention settings or deletion mechanisms. missing for 10: user-configurable retention controls, explicit data deletion API or process, detailed first-party retention/deletion documentation beyond a marketing claim, independent corroboration of the zero-retention behavior.
